theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.card_normalIdx (m : ℕ) :
Fintype.card (TemperleyLiebNormalForm.NormalIdx m) = catalan (m + 1)

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.equivDyck (m : ℕ) :
TemperleyLiebNormalForm.NormalIdx m ≃ { d : DyckWord // d.semilength = m + 1 }

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.readJ_wordOf {m : ℕ} (I J : Finset (Fin m)) :
readJ (wordOf m (toNat I) (toNat J)) = J

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.readI_wordOf {m : ℕ} (I J : Finset (Fin m)) :
readI (wordOf m (toNat I) (toNat J)) = I

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.ofDyck {m : ℕ} (d : { d : DyckWord // d.semilength = m + 1 }) :
TemperleyLiebNormalForm.NormalIdx m

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.toList_eq_wordOf {m : ℕ} (d : DyckWord) (hd : d.semilength = m + 1) :
↑d = wordOf m (toNat (readI ↑d)) (toNat (readJ ↑d))

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.mem_toNat_readJ {m : ℕ} (w : List DyckStep) {y : ℕ} (hy : y < m) :
y ∈ toNat (readJ w) ↔ w[2 * y + 2]? = some DyckStep.U

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.mem_toNat_readI {m : ℕ} (w : List DyckStep) {y : ℕ} (hy : y < m) :
y ∈ toNat (readI w) ↔ w[2 * y + 1]? = some DyckStep.D

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.readJ {m : ℕ} (w : List DyckStep) :
Finset (Fin m)

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.readI {m : ℕ} (w : List DyckStep) :
Finset (Fin m)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.semilength_toDyck {m : ℕ} (p : TemperleyLiebNormalForm.NormalIdx m) :
(toDyck p).semilength = m + 1

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.toDyck {m : ℕ} (p : TemperleyLiebNormalForm.NormalIdx m) :
DyckWord

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.normal_iff {m : ℕ} (I J : Finset (Fin m)) :
(J.card = I.card ∧ ∀ (x : Fin m), {x_1 ∈ I | x_1 ≤ x}.card ≤ {x_1 ∈ J | x_1 ≤ x}.card) ↔ pc (toNat J) m = pc (toNat I) m ∧ ∀ x < m, pc (toNat I) (x + 1) ≤ pc (toNat J) (x + 1)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.pc_toNat_card {m : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin m)) :
pc (toNat I) m = I.card

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.pc_toNat_le {m : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin m)) (x : Fin m) :
pc (toNat I) (↑x + 1) = {x_1 ∈ I | x_1 ≤ x}.card

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.pc_toNat {m : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin m)) (n : ℕ) :
pc (toNat I) n = {y ∈ I | ↑y < n}.card

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.mem_toNat {m : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin m)) (k : ℕ) :
k ∈ toNat I ↔ ∃ (h : k < m), ⟨k, h⟩ ∈ I

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.toNat {m : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin m)) :
Finset ℕ

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.card_of_balance {m : ℕ} {I J : Finset ℕ} (hbal : cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U (2 * m + 2) = cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D (2 * m + 2)) :
pc J m = pc I m

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.dom_of_prefix {m : ℕ} {I J : Finset ℕ} (hpre : ∀ t ≤ 2 * m + 2, cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D t ≤ cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U t) (x : ℕ) :
x < m → pc I (x + 1) ≤ pc J (x + 1)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.semilength_of_card {m : ℕ} {I J : Finset ℕ} (hcard : pc J m = pc I m) :
cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U (2 * m + 2) = m + 1

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.balance_of_card {m : ℕ} {I J : Finset ℕ} (hcard : pc J m = pc I m) :
cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U (2 * m + 2) = cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D (2 * m + 2)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.prefix_of_dom {m : ℕ} {I J : Finset ℕ} (hdom : ∀ x < m, pc I (x + 1) ≤ pc J (x + 1)) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ 2 * m + 2) :
cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D t ≤ cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U t

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.pc_le_of_dom {m : ℕ} {I J : Finset ℕ} (hdom : ∀ x < m, pc I (x + 1) ≤ pc J (x + 1)) (x : ℕ) :
x ≤ m → pc I x ≤ pc J x

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.count_wordOf (m : ℕ) (I J : Finset ℕ) (a : DyckStep) :
List.count a (wordOf m I J) = cnt (step m I J) a (2 * m + 2)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.count_take_wordOf (m : ℕ) (I J : Finset ℕ) (a : DyckStep) (i : ℕ) :
List.count a (List.take i (wordOf m I J)) = cnt (step m I J) a (min i (2 * m + 2))

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.wordOf (m : ℕ) (I J : Finset ℕ) :
List DyckStep

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.cnt_last {m : ℕ} (I J : Finset ℕ) :
cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U (2 * m + 2) = cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U (2 * m + 1) ∧ cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D (2 * m + 2) = cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D (2 * m + 1) + 1

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.cnt_even {m : ℕ} (I J : Finset ℕ) {x : ℕ} (hx : x < m) :
(cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U (2 * x + 2) = cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U (2 * x + 1) + if x ∈ I then 0 else 1) ∧ cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D (2 * x + 2) = cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D (2 * x + 1) + if x ∈ I then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.cnt_odd {m : ℕ} (I J : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ) :
x ≤ m → cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.U (2 * x + 1) + pc I x = 1 + x + pc J x ∧ cnt (step m I J) DyckStep.D (2 * x + 1) + pc J x = pc I x + x

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.step_even {m : ℕ} (I J : Finset ℕ) (y : ℕ) :
step m I J (2 * y + 2) = if y ∈ J then DyckStep.U else DyckStep.D

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.step_odd {m : ℕ} (I J : Finset ℕ) {y : ℕ} (hy : y < m) :
step m I J (2 * y + 1) = if y ∈ I then DyckStep.D else DyckStep.U

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.step_last (m : ℕ) (I J : Finset ℕ) :
step m I J (2 * m + 1) = DyckStep.D

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.step_zero (m : ℕ) (I J : Finset ℕ) :
step m I J 0 = DyckStep.U

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.step (m : ℕ) (I J : Finset ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
DyckStep

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.count_map_range (f : ℕ → DyckStep) (a : DyckStep) (t : ℕ) :
List.count a (List.map f (List.range t)) = cnt f a t

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.cnt_add_two (f : ℕ → DyckStep) (a : DyckStep) (t : ℕ) :
cnt f a (t + 2) = (cnt f a t + if f t = a then 1 else 0) + if f (t + 1) = a then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.cnt_succ (f : ℕ → DyckStep) (a : DyckStep) (t : ℕ) :
cnt f a (t + 1) = cnt f a t + if f t = a then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.cnt_zero (f : ℕ → DyckStep) (a : DyckStep) :
cnt f a 0 = 0

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.cnt (f : ℕ → DyckStep) (a : DyckStep) (t : ℕ) :
ℕ

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.pc_succ (S : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ) :
pc S (x + 1) = pc S x + if x ∈ S then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.pc_zero (S : Finset ℕ) :
pc S 0 = 0

def QOU.MathlibExt.TemperleyLiebNormalIdxCatalan.pc (S : Finset ℕ) (x : ℕ) :
ℕ
